problem_statement: The model can overfit assignment, but normal medium Stage 1 training collapses to one foreground slot. This suggests a slot-competition/training-schedule failure rather than an unlearnable assignment head.

settings.schedule_description: K2-only attribution upper reference; not a final mixed Stage 1 protocol.
Long k2-only specialization, then 3:1 and 1:1 reintroduction with gentle coupling.
K2-only specialization followed by mixed training with fixed k2 replay batches.
Align-only k2 warmup, then mixed training with gradual count/exist warmup.
Freeze slot queries during mixed reintroduction to protect specialized foreground slots.
Disable deterministic coupling during mixed k1 reintroduction.

cause_analysis.conclusion: staged Stage 1 protocol is viable; next step should freeze formal Stage 1 schedule and rerun with larger sample.
